component.name: A50 Control
component.summary: Settings for the ASTRO A50 Gen 4 wireless headset

description.p: Unofficial Linux replacement for the Windows-only configuration software of the ASTRO A50 (Gen 4) base station: 5-band equalizer with three presets, noise gate, microphone EQ and level, sidetone, stream port mix, default balance, alert volume, LED brightness and auto power-off.
Not affiliated with ASTRO Gaming or Logitech.
